v1_1_changes: Item 1: Added shortspear / longspear / boar-spear / ranseur + variant-spelling weapon tokens per gandalf Stage 1 spot-check verdict § 6.3 REQUIRED #1.

Item 2: Added compound_suffix_tokens block (script-level rule) — suffix-match pattern fires `blade`/`sword`/`axe`/`hammer` tokens within compound words (e.g., spiritblade, lightblade, doomaxe, warhammer*). Implementation lives in populate_proxy_fingerprint_v1_1.py find_compound_suffix_match(). UPDATE-only-on-improve discipline guards existing high-conf rows.
Plural compound forms (blades/swords/axes/hammers) also covered by suffix-match pattern.
ranseur was already present in v1.0 (mid/single/low/STR) — preserved unchanged; redundant entry in v1_1_changes for clarity.
matching_rules: Token matched on canonical_name lowercased; whole-word boundary preferred over substring.
Tokens defined as longest-match-wins; multi-word tokens (e.g., 'war hammer') beat single-word tokens (e.g., 'hammer').
If multiple tokens match, the highest-specificity token wins (specificity tier in entry).
Confidence tier per token reflects how cleanly the token implies the 4-tuple; ambiguous tokens carry lower base confidence.

v1.1: compound_suffix_tokens (`blade`/`sword`/`axe`/`hammer`) also fire as suffix-pattern matches within compound words (spiritblade → blade-low-spec) when no whole-word weapon token already matches; preserves UPDATE-only-on-improve.

compound_suffix_tokens._doc: Suffix-pattern tokens. Fire when the canonical_name contains a word ending in (but longer than) the suffix. Single-word match (e.g., bare 'blade') already covered by existing whole-word matcher; this rule only adds the compound case.
compound_suffix_tokens.plural_handling: Strip trailing 's' from compound suffix before match (Blades → blade; Swords → sword; Hammers → hammer; Axes → axe). Plurality has no semantic impact on fingerprint.
compound_suffix_tokens.fingerprint_assignment: When suffix matches a compound word: use suffix-token base fingerprint (range/geometry/tempo) AND apply attribute disambiguation by prefix hint (DEX if any dex_hint prefix substring; STR fallback otherwise). Specificity = 'low' → confidence base 0.45 per v1.0 confidence_tiers. UPDATE-only-on-improve: written only if currently-NULL or current confidence < 0.30.

v1_1_added_tokens._doc: ranseur (mid/single/low/STR) already present in v1.0 tokens block; no duplicate entry. Stage 0 alignment per dispatch: ranseur is a polearm variant; same bins as boar-spear were considered but v1.0 'mid/low' is preserved as the more accurate polearm-tier shape.
